gappers.catalyst: Q3 2026 results out pre-market; reports of a new $1B at-the-market share offering also cited.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Oklo reported Q3 2026 results before the open (call 8:30 ET). Pre-open pop ~12.8% per Investing.com; one source notes a new up-to-$1B ATM program. No reactor revenue until the 2028 start-up target.
gappers.why: Earnings relief on a heavily sold name, momentum buyers chase; ATM supply caps upside.
gappers.impact: Gap driven by one print on thin pre-market volume (127k); ATM dilution makes fade risk high. Sector read: nuclear/AI-power names sold off this week (BE -17%).
gappers.horizon_reason: Headline/earnings-driven, ATM overhang, no new durable thesis; do not carry.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Would displace any existing holding or higher-quality setups; 10% trail stop on a gap-extended, volatile name makes 2:1 R:R doubtful. Not clearing the bar without a pullback entry.

gappers.catalyst: Selected by NASA to provide spacecraft platform and mission solutions (Nov 4 press release).
gappers.catalyst_detail: Intuitive Machines announced selection to provide a spacecraft platform and mission solutions for NASA. Stock closed Nov 4 near $9.93, -5.5%, then gapped up from $8.615 prev close. Follow-up fundamentals search returned nothing.
gappers.why: Government contract win pulls in space-theme momentum buyers.
gappers.impact: Volume just at 50k floor; space peers (RDW +7.9, RKLB +7.0) also up so move is sector-wide, which supports follow-through but also reads as theme bounce.
gappers.horizon_reason: Sector-bounce plus contract headline; no sized backlog figure found, treat as swing fade risk.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Space is already a crowded theme (RDW, RKLB same list); taking LUNR displaces a stronger peer like RKLB. R:R at 7% max loss would need 14%+ target; unproven.

gappers.catalyst: Plans significant US manufacturing expansion; >$165M new orders since last update, >$270M since June 30.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Ondas announced a major US manufacturing expansion and over $165M in new orders since its last update (>$270M since Jun 30). Q3 results consensus: revenue ~$148M, EPS -0.13; earnings date not confirmed in search. Shares closed Nov 5 at 4.52 (-14%) on 65M volume.
gappers.why: Order backlog and capacity expansion reassure after a sharp -14% drop; dip-buy bounce.
gappers.impact: Highest volume of the list; but today's gap only partly retraces yesterday's 14% drop, so reads as mean-reversion bounce. Defense/drone peers not confirmed moving.
gappers.horizon_reason: Bounce after selloff; durable only if Q3 print confirms order conversion into revenue.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Sub-$5 name with wide ranges; stop at 10% trail is inside normal daily range. Likely fails 2:1 R:R; ranks below RKLB/RDW as sector exposure.

gappers.catalyst_detail: No Rigetti-specific news. Stock is down ~26% over 30 days and ~53% YTD. Quantum names rebounded Nov 4 after a post-election rout in AI/semis; TipRanks flags Q4 C-DAC system revenue recognition as the next catalyst. QBTS also +7.75% today.
gappers.why: Sector oversold bounce, no stock-specific driver.
gappers.impact: Sympathy move with QBTS; no fundamental trigger, likely to fade with the tape.
gappers.horizon_reason: Sector beta bounce, no durable thesis.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Would displace nothing of higher quality; downtrend (-26% 30d) and no catalyst fail Confluence rule. R:R not supportable.

gappers.catalyst: AI neocloud rebound ahead of Q3 earnings Nov 12 before open; prior sell-off on financing worries and election-driven AI/permit risk.
gappers.catalyst_detail: NBIS fell ~6.7% Nov 5 to ~141 and is ~53% off highs, with concern about financing and data-center permit risk after the US election. A $3.5B Citi facility supports its build; Q3 results due Nov 12 pre-market. Today's gap is from a 120.35 prior close.
gappers.why: Oversold bounce plus pre-earnings positioning in a heavily shorted name (~20% short per SA).
gappers.impact: Volume 119k pre-market is decent; CoreWeave also up 5.5%, so neocloud sector read-through is positive but it is a bounce within a downtrend.
gappers.horizon_reason: Pre-earnings bounce; earnings Nov 12 is a binary event, avoid carrying through without edge.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Binary earnings in 4 sessions; at 10% stop the risk is sized large on a ~$130 name. Competes with CRWV for the same theme; only worth it after confirmation above gap.
